`engine: gotmpl` renders the body with Go html/template: `{{.title}}`, `{{range .events}}…{{end}}`, `{{if .logged_in}}`, `{{.param_city}}`, `{{.user.email}}`. Interactivity is plain HTMX (hx-post, hx-get, hx-target); the mustache directives and pipes don't exist here.

Frontmatter `queries:` maps names to SQL: each result is `.name`, a list of rows, except a statement ending in `LIMIT 1` or one selecting only aggregates (COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/TOTAL, no GROUP BY), which is a single row (an empty map when there is none). Binds: `:user_id`, `:user_email`, `:user_role`, `:user_group_id` (NULL without a value) and `:param_<name>` (NULL when absent or empty); any other `:name` fails the query. Details: api({at:'frontend'}) gotmpl_queries. `sources:` declares single-table reports (api({at:'query'})).

Helpers: Sprig's functions (upper, lower, default, printf, date, add, …; minus env/expandenv, getHostByName and the key generators) plus `csrf` (writes a hidden _csrf input and the csrf-token meta tag; you rarely need it), `env "KEY"` (the app's env value), `t "key"` (i18n) and `dict`. There is no `.csrf` value: `value="{{.csrf}}"` renders empty.

A gotmpl page is parsed and test-rendered without data when it is written and by `benmore check`: a template syntax error, an unknown function, a wrong number of arguments, and mustache or directive syntax left in the page (`{{#rows}}`, `{{x | pipe}}`, `<page>`, `<include>`, `:create=`) are refused, naming the line.
